verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal coding agent, so an issue-to-PR workflow is a fair question for it. The evidence shows headless/CI execution, code-editing tools and goal-driven multi-turn runs. Nothing shows it reading a tracked issue or opening a pull request. Those features are adjacent building blocks a user could script around, not a documented issue-to-PR capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
